about_the_game:
Erimos: Blood and Dust is a challenging dark fantasy Soulslike action RPG set in a cursed desert kingdom where the sun never sets and God no longer speaks.

Players take on the role of a half divine exile seeking to reclaim their broken soul by defeating the seven guardians of its fragments and uncovering hidden truths buried beneath the sands.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Intense melee and magic combat: Master a variety of weapons and spells, each with unique combos and strategic uses. stamina management, and dodging to survive brutal enemies and bosses.

  • Deep character progression: Customize your build through leveling attributes like strength, agility, intelligence, and vitality. Unlock new abilities and spells by retriving soul fragments or blood 

  • Exploration and world design: The main environment is a vast desert where you can discover portals that lead to short, self contained journeys in unique locations.

  • Challenging boss battles: Face off against multi phase bosses that require skill, pattern recognition, and strategy to defeat.

  • Visual Style: A blend of stylized and realistic graphics, creating a unique dark fantasy atmosphere.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violence and gore during gameplay.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB or GTX 1650 Super
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i7 8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
